text.body: Coordinate C3: 28 graph properties carried verbatim in this document's bimba field.

properties.q_0_revealed_from_entity: C3 Process has nothing to organise until something stands to be organised. Its thrown ground is C2 — the family's atomic entities — for in the C-family's own derivation chain the Entity 'reveals its processual nature as' Process (CLAUDE.md II.E): process is not posited, it is disclosed out of already-related units. Beneath C2 lies the raw archetype #3 (Pattern) emerging from #2 (Operation): the canvas cannot pattern anything until operative atoms exist to be patterned, just as the matheme's pulse of Becoming presupposes the two poles it oscillates between. C3's void-pole is therefore double. First, it presupposes the prior population of the typology with definable Forms (C1) and atomic Entities (C2) whose couplings it will lay out. Second — and this is its proper darkness — it presupposes the not-yet: the live architecture diagram still under active spec development, the workflow not yet stable, the canvas in motion that 'remains Seed evidence until crystallised' (C3.md). C3 stands on the unstabilised: every process-form it will hold was once an undeveloped diagram, and the horizon it arises from is precisely that field of process-in-formation that has not yet earned the name of a reusable type. The ground of Process is process-before-it-can-be-categorised.
properties.q_3_process_form_lattice: C3's home structure is the process-form lattice (C3.md): MOC-Canvas-Forms, Architecture-Diagram-Forms, Workflow-Patterns, Process-Canvases, and Ideal-Canvas/Diagram-Templates. In the C family's register, Process does not mean a running computation but a KIND of durable artifact — a thing whose lasting meaning is a process or visual workspace. Its formal truth is the canvas: the patterned surface on which a becoming takes a shareable shape. Live architecture diagrams still under spec stay Seed evidence; only when their shape stabilises do they become C3 type-forms — the structure of how a thing develops, held as a reusable workspace rather than a shapeless flux.
properties.q_4_so_things_can_become: C3 is FOR development — it exists so the vault can type things whose meaning is a process, not just static entities; so a workflow, an architecture, a canvas has a home as a reusable form. Its why is the canvas as durable becoming: Hen uses C3 when an artifact's lasting meaning IS a process or visual workspace, letting stable canvas and diagram forms become type evidence. Without C3, the typology could name things and kinds but not the shapes of their unfolding.
properties.q_5_process_categorized_into_type: C3 completes by categorisation — Process is 'Categorized into' C4 (CLAUDE.md II.E). The patterns a becoming reveals are gathered into kinds: what unfolds repeatedly becomes a recognisable type, and stable process-forms hand forward to C4's type-authorities (and graduate to flat World via C5). The canvas hands its patterns on to be classed — the becoming completes by yielding the type it was becoming.
